## Summary
```{r}
LOH_MSI <- fread(paste0(path_APMall, "/LOH_MSI_final_B.csv")) %>% filter(MSI_mut == "MSS")

summary_proj <- LOH_MSI %>%
  dplyr::count(histology_abbreviation, proj) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = proj,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(histology_abbreviation)

prop_proj <- as.data.frame(table(LOH_MSI$histology_abbreviation, LOH_MSI$primary))

summary_sampletype <- LOH_MSI %>%
  dplyr::count(histology_abbreviation, primary) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = primary,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(histology_abbreviation)

summary <- inner_join(summary_proj, summary_sampletype, by = "histology_abbreviation")
write.csv(summary, file= paste0(path_APMall, "/PCAWG_samplelist.csv"), row.names = F)
write.csv(summary, file= "~/Desktop/2026-02-16_Draft/Revision/R2Major10/PCAWG_samplelist.csv", row.names = F)

df_sorted <- LOH_MSI %>% 
  mutate(project = ifelse(proj == "tcga", "TCGA", "ICGC")) %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation) %>%
  mutate(total_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(histology_abbreviation = fct_reorder(histology_abbreviation, total_count))

plot_tumorstatus <- ggplot(df_sorted, aes(x = histology_abbreviation, fill = primary)) +
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Tumor Status",
    x = "",
    y = "Number",
    fill = "Primary Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(vjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Primary" = "#377EB8",
    "Metastatic" = "#E64B35FF",
    "Recurrent" = "#00CD66"
  ))

plot_proj <-ggplot(df_sorted, aes(x = histology_abbreviation, fill = project)) +
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Project",
    x = "",
    y = "Number",
    fill = "Project"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(vjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "TCGA" = "#008B8B",
    "ICGC" = "#7A378B"
  ))

plot_combined <- plot_proj + plot_tumorstatus 
ggsave(filename = paste0(path_figure, "/SFigure1.pdf"), plot = plot_combined, width = 9, height = 5, units = "in")
```
